exposure: Prenatal diagnosis of transposition of great arteries (TGA)
cohort: 243 newborns who underwent arterial switch operation (ASO) for transposition of the great arteries (TGA)
finding: Among newborns undergoing ASO for TGA, prenatal diagnosis is associated with poorer early postoperative outcomes, partly mediated by earlier gestational age at birth.
birth_weight: Lower centile in those diagnosed prenatally
